content: {"episode_id":"ep-05036","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229), acknowledging that prior authorization was missing. The clinical indication note documents recurrent palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and supraventricular tachycardia. Given the intermittent symptoms and the need for continuous rhythm correlation over an extended period, mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture and characterize the underlying arrhythmias."}
